description: Patches applied to the locked ophub/linux-<series> kernel source before compilation. Applied with git apply after a --check pre-flight; any failure stops the build.

patches.description: mt76: mt7663s: W103D: own MAC via UNI DEV_INFO, JOIN grant handling (returned 4 s after association on 7663mp firmware so connected scans use the N9 online scan; held on older firmware), TXS rate attribution, REPORTS_TX_ACK_STATUS, firmware RX BA events in process context (v22, board-tested on 6.18.54-ophub with N9 7663mp1827 and 3.1.1)
